snippet.title: Warhammer: Dark Omen (Classic) - Steam Trailer
snippet.description:
Check it out on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4280860/Warhammer_Dark_Omen_Classic/

Originally released in 1998, Warhammer: Dark Omen has quietly earned its place as a beloved classic in the Warhammer Fantasy universe. Its atmospheric storytelling, early use of 3D battlefields, and memorable characters left a gentle but lasting impression on many players. Decades later, it has become a cherished cult classic that players still speak of with admiration and fond nostalgia.
